# gi.gis_geometry.calculate_gis_geometry { #bedrock_ge.gi.gis_geometry.calculate_gis_geometry }

```python
gi.gis_geometry.calculate_gis_geometry(no_gis_brgi_db, verbose=True)
```

Calculates GIS geometry for tables in a Bedrock Ground Investigation database.

This function processes a dictionary of DataFrames containing Ground Investigation (GI) data,
adding appropriate GIS geometry to each table. It handles both 2D and 3D geometries,
including vertical boreholes and sampling locations.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                                                 | Description                                                                                                                                            | Default    |
|----------------|------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| no_gis_brgi_db | Dict\[str, Union\[pd.DataFrame, gpd.GeoDataFrame\]\] | Dictionary containing the Bedrock GI database tables without GIS geometry. Keys are table names, values are either pandas DataFrames or GeoDataFrames. | _required_ |
| verbose        | bool                                                 | Whether to print progress information. Defaults to True.                                                                                               | `True`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                          | Description                                                                       |
|--------|-------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | Dict\[str, gpd.GeoDataFrame\] | Dict[str, gpd.GeoDataFrame]: Dictionary containing the Bedrock GI database tables |
|        | Dict\[str, gpd.GeoDataFrame\] | with added GIS geometry. All tables are converted to GeoDataFrames with           |
|        | Dict\[str, gpd.GeoDataFrame\] | appropriate CRS and geometry columns.                                             |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                                                       |
|--------|------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | ValueError | If the projects in the database use different Coordinate Reference Systems (CRS). |

## Note {.doc-section .doc-section-note}

The function performs the following operations:
1. Verifies all projects use the same CRS
2. Calculates GIS geometry for the 'Location' table
3. Creates a 'LonLatHeight' table for 2D visualization
4. Processes 'Sample' table if present
5. Processes all tables starting with "InSitu_"
